title: "key-spacing" crashes eslint on object literal shorthand properties

labels.name: accepted
labels.description: There is consensus among the team that this change meets the criteria for inclusion

labels.name: archived due to age
labels.description: This issue has been archived; please open a new issue for any further discussion

body:
Hi, I'm using shorthand properties for object literals in my code, and after I've added `key-spacing` rule to `.eslintrc`, `eslint` (version 1.2.0) throws an unhandled exception:

`index.js`:

``` javascript
var a = 'a';
var b = 'b';

export default {
    a,
    b
};
```

`.eslintrc`:

``` json
{
    "rules": {
        "indent": [
            2,
            4
        ],

        "key-spacing": [2, { "align": "value" }],

        "quotes": [
            2,
            "single"
        ],
        "linebreak-style": [
            2,
            "windows"
        ],
        "semi": [
            2,
            "always"
        ]
    },
    "env": {
        "es6": true,
        "node": true
    },
    "ecmaFeatures": {
    "modules": true,
    "blockBindings": true,
        "classes": true,
        "objectLiteralShorthandProperties": true,
        "objectLiteralShorthandMethods": true
    },
    "extends": "eslint:recommended"
}
```

eslint output:

```
PS G:\test> eslint .\index.js
C:\Users\belym.andrey\AppData\Roaming\npm\node_modules\eslint\lib\rules\key-spacing.js:127
        while (node.type !== "Punctuator" || node.value !== ":") {
                                          ^
TypeError: Cannot read property 'type' of undefined
    at getFirstNodeBeforeColon (C:\Users\belym.andrey\AppData\Roaming\npm\node_modules\eslint\lib\rules\key-spacing.js:127:43)
    at getKeyWidth (C:\Users\belym.andrey\AppData\Roaming\npm\node_modules\eslint\lib\rules\key-spacing.js:183:24)
    at Array.map (native)
    at verifyGroupAlignment (C:\Users\belym.andrey\AppData\Roaming\npm\node_modules\eslint\lib\rules\key-spacing.js:237:33)
    at C:\Users\belym.andrey\AppData\Roaming\npm\node_modules\eslint\lib\rules\key-spacing.js:271:13
    at Array.forEach (native)
    at verifyAlignment (C:\Users\belym.andrey\AppData\Roaming\npm\node_modules\eslint\lib\rules\key-spacing.js:270:28)
    at EventEmitter.ObjectExpression (C:\Users\belym.andrey\AppData\Roaming\npm\node_modules\eslint\lib\rules\key-spacing.js:312:21)
    at emitOne (events.js:82:20)
    at EventEmitter.emit (events.js:169:7)
```

Exception gone after removing `key-spacing` rule from `.eslintrc`.
